task.title: Add optional Postgres store pilot for source-ingest and search
task.summary_zh: 為 source-ingest/search 增加 optional Postgres-backed store pilot；JSONL 仍是 default baseline，透過 env 啟用 Postgres，驗證 write ownership 與 read-only sharing 邊界。
acceptance: optional Postgres store can be enabled by env without breaking JSONL default
source evidence write owner remains source-ingest
search reads durable evidence through owned boundary or read-only contract
tests cover JSONL default and Postgres pilot path
